title: 第9章 八岁出嫁
slug: 江南第一媳全本免费-江南第一媳最新章节列表
content_zh:
烟雨江南、桃花三月，八岁的林馨儿出嫁了！
一个八岁的女孩子，对出嫁应该不会有太多的想法，她也想象不出来；可是，若这女孩子身体内藏着一个成人的灵魂呢？对这桩婚事还能无动于衷吗？
林馨儿前世叫林心儿，是新时代的新女性，面上笑靥如花，内心狡诈如狐。这个性子，让她在信息爆炸的时代混得风生水起。也许人生太得意了，她居然在二十八岁那年得了莫名其妙的病，一命呜呼了！
林心儿认为，天妒英才！
上天还算对她不错，又给了她在异世重活的机会，那她就不能浪费了，得好好地活，对不对？
可是，这穿过来的家庭背景什么的都不是问题，问题是：谁会在八岁就出嫁？她前世二十八还没出嫁呢。
除非娶童养媳！
可是，她那素未谋面的小夫君是当朝尚书的嫡子，又不是娶不上媳妇，至于娶个童养媳吗？
林馨儿坚定地认为：天上不可能掉馅饼！
莫不是个病秧子，娶她过去冲喜的？
听说夫君身体康健，活蹦乱跳！
那肯定是长得丑陋不堪？
听说夫君眉目俊秀，齿白唇红！
林馨儿恐惧了：那他一定是个傻子！
听说夫君聪慧无双，号称“神童”，八岁能诗……
林馨儿捧着胸口幸福地晕倒：这么好的事，怎么就落在她头上鸟？肯定是做梦吧！
千般猜测、万般揣摩都没有用，林家不过是徽州府歙县的小户人家，怎敢拒绝诗书翰墨之家王氏的求亲？高兴还来不及呢，忙忙地就把林馨儿打扮了送上花轿。
胳膊拗不过大腿，林馨儿也只能走一步算一步，准备去到王家看看再说，若王家不能待，再想法子逃走。
她林馨儿这里，从来就没有过不去的坎儿！
于是，八岁的小新娘上了八人抬大轿。

一个孩子的重量当然无需八个人来抬，用八人大轿，充分说明夫家对这个儿媳的重视！
林馨儿把烦心事先放一边，先感受这古代的婚嫁仪式：真是热闹啊！凡过村镇，锣鼓敲得那个激情，唢呐吹得那个欢畅，大把的撒喜钱和喜果，引得村童们哄抢；过了村镇，锣鼓停了，喜乐转为悠扬悦耳的笙箫，深情婉转，引得道旁山野的男女纷纷侧首观望、满目艳羡……
那天是三月初八，一路烟雨迷蒙，一路桃李芬芳！
林馨儿觉得，能这样嫁一回，值了！
她可不是苦中作乐，是真这么想。
等到了王家，种种热闹规矩更是花样繁多，弄得林馨儿心中也急跳起来，有些忘乎所以，好像真嫁了个美满姻缘。
拜天地，入洞房！
很快，新郎掀盖头了。
洞房内忽然安静下来。
林馨儿坐在华丽的千工拔步床上，心里欢快地唱：掀起你的盖头来，让我来看看你的脸儿……
她也急着掀盖头，不是为了让对方看自己，而是为了让自己看新郎。盖头一掀开，她就能看见小新郎什么模样、是否痴傻，再决定是留下来还是卷包袱跑路。
盖头掀开了，她眼前一亮，跟着一呆。
她清楚感到，面前的王亨也是一呆。
她的小新郎和传闻一样：眉目俊秀、齿白唇红，更突出的是他有一双黑亮的眸子，在烛光的折射下，放出璀璨的光芒，像明星一样耀目。而王亨也凝视着她的眼睛：这双眼睛并不顶大，睫毛又长又密，在睫毛的笼罩下，黑眸雾蒙蒙的幽深。他一直看进她眼底，神情惊喜，还有点羞涩。
两个孩子一眨不眨地对视。
这一刻，时间仿若静止。
旁边喜娘也未打搅他们。
还是王亨先打破平静，他一屁股坐到床沿上，挨着林馨儿，凑近她小脸，笑嘻嘻问道：“妹妹叫什么名字？”
瞧，一听就没上心，连新娘叫什么都不知道！
林馨儿把头一歪，反问道：“你叫什么名字？”

王亨见她不似家人口中说的新娘扭扭捏捏，又可爱又大方，心中大喜，当即回道：“我叫王亨！《易经》的乾卦和坤卦的卦辞：元亨利贞。亨就是通的意思。”
哎哟，这么复杂？
林馨儿道：“我叫林馨儿。馨香的馨。”
王亨眼睛一亮，道：“馨儿？这个名字好！不俗不贵，正是小家碧玉的韵味。《乐府诗集》有碧玉歌：碧玉小家女，不敢攀贵德。感郎义气重，遂得结金兰。”

content_en:
In the misty Jiangnan and peach blossoms in March, eight-year-old Lin Xiner got married!
An eight-year-old girl shouldn't have many thoughts about getting married, and she couldn't imagine it; but what if there was an adult soul hidden in this girl's body? Can you still remain indifferent to this marriage?
In her previous life, Lin Xin'er was called Lin Xin'er. She was a new woman in the new era, with a smile as bright as a flower and a fox-like heart. This temperament allows her to thrive in the era of information explosion. Perhaps she was too proud of her life. She actually contracted an inexplicable illness at the age of twenty-eight and died!
Lin Xin'er thinks that God is jealous of talented people!
God was kind to her and gave her a chance to live again in another world, so she couldn't waste it and lived well, right?
However, the family background is not a problem. The question is: who will get married at the age of eight? In her previous life, she was twenty-eight and not yet married.
Unless you marry a child bride!
However, her young husband, whom she had never met before, was the legitimate son of the minister of the dynasty. He couldn't get a wife, so how about marrying a child bride?
Lin Xiner firmly believes: There is no way for pie to fall from the sky!
Could it be that he was a sick man who married her just for fun?
I heard that my husband is in good health and active!
That must be ugly?
I heard that my husband has handsome features, white teeth and red lips!
Lin Xiner was frightened: Then he must be a fool!
It is said that my husband is extremely intelligent, known as a "child prodigy", and can write poems at the age of eight...
Lin Xiner held her chest and fainted happily: How could such a good thing happen to her? It must be a dream!
All speculations and speculations are in vain. The Lin family is just a small family in She County, Huizhou Prefecture. How dare they refuse the marriage proposal of the Wang family, a family of poetry, calligraphy and calligraphy? It was too late to be happy, so she hurriedly dressed up Lin Xiner and sent her to the sedan chair.
With her arms unable to hold her thighs, Lin Xiner could only take one step at a time, preparing to go to the Wang family to have a look, and if the Wang family couldn't stay, she would try to escape.
There is never anything that she, Lin Xiner, can't overcome!
So, the eight-year-old bride got on the big sedan chair carried by eight people.
Of course, eight people do not need to carry the weight of a child. The use of an eight-person sedan fully demonstrates the importance that the husband's family attaches to their daughter-in-law!
Lin Xiner put aside her worries first and experienced the ancient wedding ceremony: It was so lively! Whenever you pass a village, the gongs and drums are beating with passion, the suona is playing with joy, and a lot of money and fruits are scattered, attracting village children to grab them; after passing a village, the gongs and drums stop, and the joy turns to the melodious and melodious shengxiao, which is affectionate and graceful, attracting men and women in the mountains and fields beside the road to look at each other with envy...
That day was the eighth day of March, it was misty and rainy all the way, and the peaches and plums were fragrant all the way!
Lin Xiner felt that it was worth it to get married like this!
She is not enjoying herself in hardship, she really thinks so.
When they arrived at the Wang family, there were even more lively rules and regulations, which made Lin Xiner's heart beat fast and she was a little carried away, as if she really had a happy marriage.
Worship heaven and earth and enter the bridal chamber!
Soon, the groom lifted his hijab.
The bridal chamber suddenly became quiet.
Lin Xiner was sitting on the gorgeous Qiangong Babu bed, singing happily in her heart: Lift your hijab, let me see your face...
She also hurriedly lifted her hijab, not to let the other party see her, but to let herself see the groom. As soon as the hijab is lifted, she can see what the young groom looks like and whether he is stupid, and then she can decide whether to stay or pack up and run away.
The hijab was lifted, her eyes lit up and she was stunned for a moment.
She clearly felt that Wang Heng in front of her was also stunned.
Her young groom was just like the rumors: he had handsome eyebrows, white teeth and red lips. What was even more striking was that he had a pair of bright black eyes, which shone brightly under the refraction of candlelight, as dazzling as a star. And Wang Heng also stared at her eyes: these eyes were not very big, and the eyelashes were long and dense. Under the shadow of the eyelashes, the black eyes were misty and deep. He kept looking into her eyes, the look on her faceSurprised, and a little shy.
The two children stared at each other without blinking.
At this moment, time seemed to stand still.
Xi Niang didn't bother them either.
It was Wang Heng who broke the calm first. He sat down on the edge of the bed next to Lin Xiner, leaned close to her face, and asked with a smile: "What's your sister's name?"
Look, I didn’t take it seriously at first sight, and I didn’t even know what the bride’s name was!
Lin Xiner tilted her head and asked, "What's your name?"
Wang Heng was overjoyed when he saw that she was not as cute and generous as the bride her family said she was. He immediately replied: "My name is Wang Heng! The hexagrams of the Qian and Kun hexagrams in the Book of Changes are: Yuan Henry Zhen. Heng means Tong."
Ouch, so complicated?
Lin Xiner said: "My name is Lin Xiner. Xinxiang Xin."
Wang Heng's eyes lit up and he said: "Xin'er? This is a good name! It's not vulgar but not expensive, which is exactly the charm of Xiaojia Biyu. "Yuefu Poetry Collection" has Biyu's song: Biyu, a little girl, dare not be virtuous. She felt her husband's loyalty, so she married Jinlan."
